doc.title: Mike Wofford interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998

title: Closing thanks
summary: Thanks, hopes for the experimental group and the search for venues, and goodbyes.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Yeah. Well this is great. I’m pleased you were able to come and join us today.
Oh, my pleasure, I really enjoyed it. Yeah, great to be here.
On behalf of the college I’d like to thank you, and I hope your experimental group flourishes.
I hope. You know, talk about few venues, that’s the hardest part of that kind of project is just finding outlets.
A little art center somewhere that you hope for.
I have to scrounge around. But they’re there.
